clocks.daily_bar_close: Known close boundary; available_at cannot precede close and must be <=snapshot decision
clocks.snapshots: Independently materialized as of each decision; no later backfill into old snapshots
clocks.execution: Separate quote observed strictly after decision, never a retrospective same-bar open

learning.loss: Capitalization-weighted training MSE; corrected AIC selects lambda
learning.selection: Positive combination coefficients; equal-average their univariate forecasts
learning.ranks: As-of feature/cap/eligibility mask only; tiedrank, constant cross-section maps0
learning.formation: Exact/Hazen quintiles, minimum25 eligible assets and5 ineachquintile; highquintile normalizedlaggedcaps
learning.targets: Missing historical labels filter fitting only; future target unavailable is absent from inference API

features.daily_prices: Validated positive OHLC, close and open inside low/high; nonnegative volume
features.history: 200 consecutive valid daily observations before a feature endpoint is eligible
features.indicator_definitions: Source-style SMA/EMA/PPO/PVO/stochastic/Bollinger/CCI/Chaikin; explicit Wilder14 RSI; no claim of bitwise MATLAB parity

accounting.mode: Isolated paper simulation only; no exchange API/writer integration
accounting.trade_execution: Sell then buy using adverse per-side slippage and fee on executed notional
accounting.target_sizing: Fee/slippage-inclusive continuous NAV fixed point, then floor quantity to lot grid; cash residual retained
accounting.minimum_orders: Atomic block; no silent removal or redistribution
accounting.missing_held_mark: Fail closed; preserve wallet and withhold NAV, never renormalize surviving positions
accounting.drawdown: 1-NAV/running_peak including initial cash and first loss
accounting.terminal_exit: Explicit cash target only, with normal order constraints
accounting.spec_validity: Point snapshot by default; optional explicit valid_until; no implicit24hTTL

changes_from_published_replication: Week-scoped resampling with fixed calendar endpoints
Explicit snapshot provenance and warmup policy
Portable Python solver and defined RSI/constant-rank behavior

admission.reason: Only synthetic implementation checks authorized in this stage; real point-in-time inputs and separate financial preregistration remain required
